terminal_decision: Do not integrate the decomposed conversation-event path into the live skill, reasoning abstraction, or graph.

B_small_window_harvesting.finding: The three harvesters were source-reliable and high-recall but produced 88-95 overlapping events per case. Complementary lenses recovered evidence across families, while exact per-family scoring mischaracterized useful cross-lens coverage.

D_end_to_end_gate.reason: Two of three cases fail closed mechanically and the one compilable case fails the frozen semantic constraint requirements.

what_worked: Turn-pair windows made local extraction operationally reliable.
Stable span IDs and deterministic exact-text resolution eliminated source-custody failures.
Every harvested and synthesized proposal received terminal custody.
Complementary probabilistic lenses recovered reviewed evidence that individual families missed.
Fail-closed composition and the graph boundary prevented invalid state from leaking downstream.
what_failed: Three overlapping harvest lenses expanded each 14-message conversation into 88-95 events, moving overload from the transcript into fan-in.
Fresh synthesis fragmented compatible plan elements and sometimes mislabeled provisional joint plans as accepted.
Thread synthesis repeatedly cited nearly every related event instead of minimal trajectory evidence and omitted the narrow reviewed concern in two cases.
Explicit source-strength definitions did not prevent inflation or recover enough earlier load-bearing constraints.
The first compiler version allowed incomplete synthesis families to compile; current custody now quarantines them.
next_redesign: Design a bounded per-window semantic consolidation step that merges overlapping lens proposals probabilistically while preserving every input and disposition; deterministic code must not decide relevance.
Cap the normalized fan-in by contract and test representation provider-free before calls.
Move claim-strength classification to the local window where attribution language is visible, then prohibit global synthesis from silently relabeling it.
Feed global position and thread synthesis consolidated turn records rather than 88-95 raw overlapping events.
Reopen provider calls only after a new provider-free representation and evaluation contract pass.
unknowns: The reviewed handoffs are useful but not exhaustive semantic gold; exact-source metrics under-credit some faithful alternative evidence.
The experiment tested one low-cost model and one sample per case, not cross-model or repeat stability.
All cases contain fourteen messages; longer real conversations may amplify fan-in overload.
No end-user utility or downstream reasoning-pressure improvement was tested because state quality did not clear the gate.
